Mali.title: Fuel in Bamako: 2,882 tankers received in November, with the FAMa ensuring the security of the convoys
Mali.summary: BAMAKO, 28 November 2026 – The system for supplying petroleum products to the Malian capital continues to gather momentum. A new convoy of 621 tanker trucks arrived in Bamako on Saturday, 28 November 2026, at 6:45 a.m., as part of efforts to increase the availability of fuel and meet the needs of the population, economic operators and various sectors of activity.

Mali.title: The FAMa and the Africa Corps are conducting...
Mali.summary: The FAMa and the Africa Corps are conducting operations against armed groups in three regions of Mali The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), with the support of the Africa Corps of the Russian Ministry of Defence, have carried out several ground and air operations against armed groups in three regions of the country, as part of the anti-terrorist operation “Dougoukoloko”.

Mali.title: Mali: Firecrackers and fireworks banned across the country
Mali.summary: Mali: Firecrackers and fireworks banned throughout the country The Ministry of Security and Civil Protection has banned the use of firecrackers, fireworks and all pyrotechnic devices throughout the country until further notice. The measure was announced in a press release dated Friday, 27 November 2026. According to the Ministry, the security situation calls for maximum vigilance.

Mali.title: Mali: Algeria deems the rapprochement between the FLA and terrorist groups "unacceptable"
Mali.summary: Mali: Algeria deems the rapprochement between the FLA and terrorist groups “unacceptable” Algeria openly disapproves of the rapprochement between the armed movements of Azawad, particularly the Front for the Liberation of Azawad (FLA), and the terrorist groups operating in Mali. . Algerian Minister of Foreign Affairs Ahmed Attaf expressed his country's position at a press conference on the security and political situation in Mali.

Mali.title: 27/11/2026 20:16 - Mali: Algiers denounces the “alliance” between the FLA separatists and the “terrorists” of JNIM
Mali.summary: 27-11-2026 20:16 - Mali: Algiers denounces the â€œallianceâ€ between the FLA separatists and the â€œterroristsâ€ of JNIM RFI-Afrique -- The Algerian Minister of Foreign Affairs made some very harsh comments about the Front for the Liberation of Azawad (FLA) during a press conference on Thursday, 26 November in Algiers. Ahmed Attaf denounced the alliance of the pro-independence rebels in northern Mali with the 'terrorist groups', namely the jihadists of the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM, linked to al-Qaeda).

Mali.title: Release of around thirty soldiers: The bold move by FAMa
Mali.summary: Release of around thirty soldiers: The bold move by the FAMa Around thirty soldiers from the Malian Armed Forces were released last week following a spectacular operation led by the Special Forces and their Russian allies. . A successful bold move in the north of the country: combat and transport helicopters, Sukhoi aircraft and state-of-the-art drones were deployed in this high-intensity mission, which confirms the growing strength of the FAMa and increasingly asserts Mali's sovereignty over its entire territory every day.

Burkina Faso.title: Entre Nous: 'Exploring the path to dialogue with JNIM'
Burkina Faso.summary: Entre Nous: ‘Exploring the path to dialogue with JNIM’ On 20 November 2024, the International Crisis Group published a report entitled: ‘The Battle for Cities: Countering the JNIM Threat to Sahel Urban Centres’ . According to this international non-profit NGO, whose mission is to prevent and help resolve deadly conflicts through field research, analysis and political advocacy, “the human cost of the conflict is already considerable and continues to mount.” .

Niger.title: Algeria stands in solidarity with Niger
Niger.summary: Algeria expressed its strong condemnation and denunciation of the terrorist attack that targeted a Nigerien National Guard post in the Sanam area of Tillabéri Region, resulting in a number of casualties and injuries, according to a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Saturday.

Niger.title: Algeria condemns the terrorist attack on a Niger National Guard post
Niger.summary: . In a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Saturday, 28 November, Algeria expressed its "strong condemnation and denunciation of the terrorist attack on a Niger National Guard post in the Sanam area of Tillabéri Region, which resulted in several casualties and injuries".

Niger.title: Dosso: Around 1,260 candidates registered for the recruitment examination for Water and Forestry Officers
Niger.summary: Dosso, 28 November (ANP) – On Saturday, 28 November, the Governor of the Dosso Region, Colonel-Major Bana Alhassane, officially launched the physical tests for the direct recruitment competition for one thousand (1,000) officers for the Water and Forestry Service, opened by Decree No. 00240 of 10 September 2020. .

Niger.title: Agadez: 68 candidates take part in the physical tests for the open competition to recruit Water and Forestry officers
Niger.summary: Agadez, 28 November (ANP) – On Saturday, 28 November 2020, the Secretary-General of the Agadez Governorate, Mr Souleymane Saidou Boulhassane, launched the physical tests for the open competitive recruitment of Water and Forestry Officers. . The ceremony was attended by the Managing Administrator of the urban municipality of Agadez, the Regional Director for the Environment and the Fight Against Desertification, and officials from the Defence and Security Forces.

Niger.title: Niger Ministry of Defence: Armed men kill 13 soldiers in the southwest of the country
Niger.summary: On Friday, the Ministry of Defence of Niger announced that 13 soldiers were killed and 20 others were injured in an attack targeting a National Guard post in the southwest of the country on Thursday, while ISIS claimed responsibility for the attack. In a statement, the ministry said that a large group of armed men carried out the attack, describing them as "terrorists", without specifying the group to which they belonged.
